limits: No AWS/STS/cluster/Datadog tenant/real-secret calls, deployments, installs, full builds, extra agents, commits, pushes or merges. Public primary documentation/source retrieval only.

No Grafana/Agent containers were run; native secret resolution, CSI ownership, IRSA/KMS authorization, login, ingestion and rotation require runtime validation. The actual pinned bootstrap guard alone was run locally with a literal reference.

Grafana datasource updates require restart; admin_password applies only to initial database creation. Existing database password changes require the approved application procedure, not only AWS/CSI rotation.

Datadog scheduled and API-failure secret refresh are disabled; key/token rotation uses a coordinated restart. A mixed-token rollout may interrupt authentication; zero-downtime token rotation is not claimed.

The Datadog renderer supports only the documented chart/images, release, namespace, region, secret handles and container layout. It rejects unreviewed credential sources and static AWS key additions; it is not a general renderer for arbitrary workloads.
